entries.statement: Each governance entity has one primary responsibility and an explicit contract.
Agents receive only the permissions required by their declared responsibility.
Registries index canonical definitions and must not duplicate their contents.
Every workspace package must strictly adhere to the 10 Sovereign Genesis Mandates.
All UI components must use canonical semantic theme tokens with zero raw hex or legacy utilities.
Celestial and mathematical algorithms must remain 100% pure functions with zero DB, network, or file I/O.
All API parameters, response shapes, and RPC contracts must originate exclusively from @moon/protocol.
Multi-step persistence mutations must run inside managed transactions with automatic rollback guarantees.
HTTP and RPC endpoints must use declarative route builders with runtime schema validation.
Primary canonical source text and provenance must never be mutated or replaced with synthetic AI output.
